scope: Source-only independent review and small process guard probe; no Docker/package-manager/network invocation.
accepted_source_checks: Explicitly disable other repositories on every microdnf invocation.
Only public UBI10 CDN HTTPS path, matching BaseOS/AppStream components, local pinned-image key path and gpgcheck permitted.
sslverify=1 and gpgcheck=1 explicitly passed to manager.
Current-base-major check, image-only cache clean and immutable output directory.
Post-exit output capacity check catches a quick finished child.
RPM before/after retains epoch, architecture and installed signature for CI review.
unverified: Actual pinned-image default .repo bytes were not read locally; multi-line keys/URLs are intentionally rejected and actual configuration match must be proved by CI build.
No actual package transaction, signature result, updated RPM version or remaining RHEL finding has yet been verified by this source review.
earlier_local_probe_note: First attempt used system Python3.9 and could not import datetime.UTC; this is a host interpreter mismatch, not evidence against target Python3.14. The existing .venv interpreter was used for this final probe.
